summary: Lemons get a 20% chance to carry Token: each scored Token Lemon pays you half your current Interest in coins.
tip: A 1-ticket interest earner: Lemons are the most common symbol, so Tokens show up often. Raise Interest with Stonks and add Lemon chance or fruit retriggers.

synergies.why: +5% Interest: at base Interest each Token pays about 70% more.
Doubles your Interest, so every Token pays double.
+1 Lemon chance for good means more Token Lemons scored.
+2 Lemon chance for the Deadline means more Token Lemons scored.
Retriggered Lemon Patterns pay their Tokens again.
Its Token chance on every symbol stacks with the 20% on Lemons.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the base chance of Lemons, so fewer Tokens.
You can only deposit after the last Round, so Interest, and every Token payout, stays tiny during the Deadline.

assumptions: A Token pays half of the Interest payout (your Interest % of the deposit), the same amount basis Lucky Cat pays in full.
Retriggered Patterns pay their Tokens again (the wiki's strategy notes for these charms say so).

summary: Lemons get a 20% chance to carry Ticket: each scored Ticket Lemon gives you 1 Clover Ticket.
tip: Pricey at 4 tickets, but Lemons are the most common symbol, so it pays back fast. Lemon chance and fruit retriggers print more; hold the tickets for CloverPet or Lost Wallet.

synergies.why: +2 Lemon chance for the Deadline means more Ticket Lemons scored.
+1 Lemon chance for good means more Ticket Lemons scored.
Retriggered Lemon Patterns pay their Tickets again.
Symbols Multiplier +1 for every 5 tickets you hold.
Patterns Multiplier +1 for every 15 tickets you hold.
Rounds pay no tickets with that memory card, so Ticket modifiers become your income.

antiSynergies.why: Halves the base chance of Lemons, so fewer Tickets.

assumptions: Each Ticket Lemon in a scored Pattern gives 1 ticket, and retriggers pay it again (wiki Clover Tickets and Monopoly Pieces pages).

summary: Every spin with 3+ Patterns permanently raises Lemons and Cherries by their base value (+2 each).
tip: A cheap fruit scaler: Luck and retriggers make 3+ Pattern spins common, and the gains stay even if you sell it later. All four Aces fuse into Poker Deck (DLC).

synergies.why: Fruit Patterns trigger twice, so fruit spins reach 3+ Patterns easily.
Repetition retriggers push spins to 3+ Patterns.
Every first spin's Patterns trigger twice, often reaching 3+.
Luck+7 on the last spin usually lands a multi-Pattern hit.
Doubles the fruit value it has built up; take it later.
With Ace of Diamonds, Spades and Clubs, fuses into Poker Deck (DLC).

antiSynergies.why: Halves Lemon and Cherry chances, so the raised fruit is scored less often.

assumptions: Retriggers count toward the 3+ Patterns, as for Lucky Cat.
The raise is permanent symbol value, so it stays after the charm is sold.

summary: Every 3 tickets you spend in the store permanently raise Clovers and Bells by their base value (+3 each).
tip: It does nothing at the slot machine, so park it in a drawer and equip it only to shop. Ticket income (Thimble, Iron, Raging Capitalist) means more raises. Aces fuse into Poker Deck (DLC).

effects.text: Counts tickets spent on store purchases, not purchases: each 3 tickets spent raise Clovers and Bells by +3 each, so a typical 2-4 ticket charm gives about one raise. Free charms add nothing, and phone rerolls are not store spending.

synergies.why: Ticket Clovers fund more shopping, and Clovers are one of the symbols it raises.
Ticket Bells fund more shopping, and Bells are one of the symbols it raises.
Its Ticket modifiers fund more purchases, and every purchase grows it too.
Its 2-ticket price counts toward the next raise, and it refunds 4.
Doubles the Clover and Bell values it has built up; take it later.
With Ace of Hearts, Diamonds and Spades, fuses into Poker Deck (DLC).

antiSynergies.why: Halves Clover and Bell chances, so the raised symbols show up less.

assumptions: Spent tickets are counted cumulatively, so leftovers carry over to the next purchase.
Modelled as one raise per purchase (when.on purchase), matching an average charm price of about 3 tickets.
The ticket price of Ace of Clubs itself does not count.
